## Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(performance)
```

## Data Wrangling
```{r cars}
tables_weekly <- read_xlsx("Water Tables/DataFiles/Capstone Data_4_22.xlsx", sheet = "Water tables")
tables_weekly$Date <- as.Date(tables_weekly$Date)

clean_tables <- tables_weekly %>% 
  separate(`Plug ID`, into = c("Transplant", "plot"), sep = "\\.") %>% 
  select("Date", "Transplant", "plot", "Shoot count":"Blade length C (cm)")


before_after <- clean_tables%>% 
  filter(Date %in% c("2026-02-28", "2026-04-18"))
```
clean_tables:
  Have NAs
  some have multiple values for one
  no hole
  no tag NO TAG
  DEAD
  GONE
  
## Data Visualization
```{r}
# Over whole 6 weeks
ggplot(clean_tables, aes(Transplant, `Shoot count`)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue")

ggplot(before_after, aes(Transplant, `Shoot count`, fill = as.factor(Date))) +
  geom_boxplot()





```

## Stats
```{r}
shoot_pois<- glm(`Shoot count` ~ Transplant, data = clean_tables, family = "poisson")

summary(shoot_pois)

check_model(shoot_pois)
check_overdispersion(shoot_pois)

ggplot(clean_tables, aes(x = Transplant, y = `Shoot count`)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'glm', method.args = list(family = 'poisson'),
              color = "black") +
  theme_bw()

Boxplot with letters

sub <- before_after %>% 
  select(Date, Transplant, `plot`, `Shoot count`) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
                    names_from = Date,
                    values_from = `Shoot count`) %>% 
  mutate(subtracted = `2026-04-18` - `2026-02-28`)

ggplot(sub, aes(Transplant, subtracted)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(clean_tables, aes(Date, `Shoot count`, color = paste(clean_tables$Transplant, clean_tables$plot)) ) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Transplant))+
  geom_line(aes(group = paste(clean_tables$Transplant, clean_tables$plot)), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Transplant)

subtracted
## just before and after experiment
bashoot_pois<- glm(subtracted ~ Transplant, data = sub)

summary(bashoot_pois) Not super meaningful with only 9 data points 

check_model(bashoot_pois)
check_overdispersion(bashoot_pois)

ggplot(before_after, aes(x = Transplant, y = `Shoot count`)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'glm', method.args = list(family = 'poisson'),
              color = "black") +
  theme_bw()
```
